highlights: The AI landscape is rapidly advancing with new specialized decision models and APIs, enabling faster and more structured AI outputs for critical tasks.
Significant progress is being made in agentic AI, with Google Cloud launching a universal enterprise agent and new research improving agent planning and error recovery for robust systems.
Efficiency and cost optimization remain a key focus, with accelerated image models, drastic reductions in browser agent costs, and innovative LLM inference marketplaces emerging to empower builders.

agents.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent for Enterprise Work
agents.summary: Google Cloud introduced Gemini Agent, a unified cloud-hosted agent for diverse enterprise tasks, offering a single prompt box and API for knowledge work, media creation, and code execution. This streamlines the development and deployment of comprehensive AI assistants across organizations.

agents.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
agents.summary: NVIDIA researchers developed PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method enabling multi-turn LLM agents to avoid and recover from early pivotal errors, significantly enhancing agent reliability and robustness in complex interactions. This is critical for building trustworthy and resilient autonomous systems.

agents.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
agents.summary: Plan-and-Patch introduces a new framework where diffusion language models generate and repair agent plans faster and more effectively than traditional autoregressive methods. This allows agents to generate structured plans through parallel unmasking and efficiently patch affected regions, crucial for long-horizon tasks.

models.title: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model
models.summary: Microsoft AI has launched Microsoft-Decision-1, a Qwen3.5-9B based decision-scoring model designed for routing, classification, verification, and agent control. It provides calibrated probabilities for fixed answer options, available through Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter, offering precise, non-generative outputs for critical decision-making.

models.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
models.summary: Alibaba’s Qwen team released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an accelerated 7B image model that generates and edits images in just 8 denoising steps, a 5x speed improvement over its predecessor. This significantly boosts efficiency for developers working with image generation and editing tasks, with a hosted API option.

models.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for Everyone
models.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 globally within ChatGPT, featuring an Intelligent UI that delivers faster responses with integrated visuals and interactive experiences. This update enhances user interaction and accessibility, making advanced AI capabilities more intuitive and engaging for a broader audience.

tools.title: OpenAI Decisions API Hits Public Beta With 10x Faster Typed Answers
tools.summary: OpenAI's Decisions API is now in public beta on GPT-6 Luna, offering 10x faster typed probabilities, choices, and scores compared to the Responses API. This provides developers with a highly efficient and cost-effective solution for rapid, structured decision outputs in their applications.

tools.title: Architect Launches Liquid Inference, a Real-Time Auction for LLM Inference
tools.summary: Architect Financial Technologies introduced Liquid Inference, an LLM router that orchestrates a real-time auction among providers for every inference request. This innovative marketplace allows developers to optimize costs by selecting the lowest compliant offer for LLM inference.

tools.title: Transformers Library Now Runs llama.cpp Quants
tools.summary: Hugging Face's Transformers library now supports `llama.cpp` quantizations, enabling developers to easily load and run highly optimized, quantized LLMs. This significantly improves efficiency and reduces memory footprint for deploying large models on diverse hardware.

companies.title: Atlassian and OpenAI Expand Partnership to Turn Enterprise Knowledge into Action
companies.summary: Atlassian and OpenAI are deepening their partnership to integrate frontier models with Atlassian's enterprise knowledge bases, empowering teams to streamline planning, building, and delivery of work. This aims to transform internal knowledge into actionable insights for improved productivity.

companies.title: Sophos Cuts Threat Investigation Time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
companies.summary: Sophos leveraged OpenAI's Daybreak to reduce cyber-threat investigation time by a remarkable 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases, all while maintaining crucial human oversight. This demonstrates the profound impact of AI in enhancing security operations and efficiency.

companies.title: Asana Cuts Model Costs 76x in Browser Tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
companies.summary: Asana successfully reduced its browser agent model costs by 76x and increased speed by 5x using OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra in Codex for browser tests. This showcases a significant breakthrough in optimizing AI model efficiency and affordability for customer-facing applications.

learning.title: Google Research RRSI Guide: Mastering Self-Improving AI Agents
learning.summary: Google Research released a comprehensive coding guide for their Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement (RRSI) framework, offering developers detailed insights into building safe, efficient, and self-improving AI agents. This guide covers noise bands, cost rules, and leakage screens for practical implementation.

learning.title: DevFest is Back, Focusing on Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: Google announced the return of DevFest 2026, a global event series connecting developers with resources and expertise to build, secure, and scale solutions in the agentic AI era. This offers valuable opportunities for learning and networking around cutting-edge AI development.

learning.title: Helping Teens Learn, Plan, and Shape the Future of AI with ChatGPT
learning.summary: ChatGPT for Teens is introducing new educational features, including a College Planner, flashcards, and quizzes, alongside a teen AI council. This initiative aims to equip young learners with AI tools for academic planning and active participation in shaping AI's future.
